test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

options.text: Our Principal is a great teacher and administrator.
Our Principal is a great teacher and a great administrator.
Our Principal is a great teacher and an administrator.
Our Principal is great teacher and administrator.

solution:
**The correct answer is option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**To answer this question, let's break down each sentence to identify the grammatically and contextually correct ones:**

__
 
• **A. Our Principal is a great teacher and administrator.**

 
 
• This sentence uses the correct conjunction "and" and omits unnecessary repetition.
 
• This sentence is grammatically and contextually correct__.
 
 
 
• **B. Our Principal is a great teacher and a great administrator.**
 __
 
• This sentence uses the article "a" twice, which is unnecessary and creates redundancy.
 
• The sentence is grammatically incorrect due to the repetition of "a great."__
 
 
 
• **C. Our Principal is a great teacher and an administrator.**
 __
 
• This sentence correctly uses the article "an" before "administrator" but introduces unnecessary repetition of articles.
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct but could be more concise.__
 
 
 
• **D. Our Principal is great teacher and administrator.**
 __
 
• This sentence omits the article "a" before "teacher," which makes it grammatically incorrect.
 
• The sentence is grammatically incorrect because "a" is needed before "teacher."__
 
 
 
• __So, the grammatically correct sentence is option A.__
 
• **Therefore, the correct answer is "Our Principal is a great teacher and administrator."**
